body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and prevent the target from moving through your space until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Pull the target 1 unit before dealing Damage.
The target cannot voluntarily move farther from you until the start of your next turn; it may burn 1 die to end this restriction.

rider.title: Combo - Finisher
rider.html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to enter Ox Stance: adjacent enemies treat spaces adjacent to you as difficult terrain while you remain in place.
